note: Presentation-layer parameters for the R1.3 worked example. Deliberately SEPARATE from calibration.json: these choices select and display cached model outputs (they change no model output), so moving a threshold must never invalidate or re-burn the grid. The threshold and cell were fixed a priori, before any flip count was computed; the selection rule is stated in the manuscript.

worked_example.threshold_rationale: a ~10% malignancy risk is the conventional BI-RADS 4b boundary at which biopsy is recommended; inside the paper's evaluated 0.05-0.5 decision-curve band

secondary_example.threshold_rationale: readmission-prevention program enrollment decisions operate near the cohort prevalence (0.112); net benefit for both arms approaches zero above t~0.3 at this prevalence, so higher thresholds are uninformative
